title: Design: Duplicate part number error looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create part A for this test at the test location, with a part number that has capital letters.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 1.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type Duplicate check in the Description box.
  3. Type part A's part number in lower case in the Part Number box.
  4. Pick any category in the Category box.
  5. Type 1 in the Cost box.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Description box shows "Duplicate check".

Step 3:

  • The Part Number box shows part A's number in lower case.

Step 4:

  • The Category box shows the picked category.

Step 5:

  • The Cost box shows "$ 1".

Step 6:

  • A red message box appears with a white warning triangle at its left and "Close" at its right.
  • The message box sits at the bottom right of the page.
  • Its first line reads part A's part number in capitals, as stocked, followed by "already exists at this location."
  • A second, smaller line under it reads "Please try to resolve this."
  • The New Inventory Part window stays open behind the message with everything you typed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S7-N3: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New part's number already stocked here, active | "{part number} already exists at this location." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.5 The same number again, in lower case". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-05-p1-5-duplicate-refused.png

The design's own words:

  • “Typing f40010212 at a location that already stocks F40010212 is refused with "F40010212 already exists at this location." (S7-N3). Upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored, and the message names the number of the part already there (S7-N5). The second line, "Please try to resolve this.", is the caption every error toast in the app carries.”
